cd /workspace && python3 - <<'PY'
p='submission/te/session.py'
s=open(p).read()
old="""    for pos, e in enumerate(live):
        v = vals[pos]
        if v > h:
            z[e] = _f(h)
            t[e] = _f(rho * (v - h))
        else:
            z[e] = _f(v)
            t[e] = 0.0
    # Clamp tiny negative pressures caused by roundoff.
    for e in live:
        if t[e] < 0.0:
            t[e] = 0.0
    return z, t, _f(h)
"""
new="""    active_edges = []
    for pos, e in enumerate(live):
        v = vals[pos]
        if v > h:
            z[e] = _f(h)
            t[e] = _f(rho * (v - h))
            active_edges.append(e)
        else:
            z[e] = _f(v)
            t[e] = 0.0
    # Clamp tiny negative pressures caused by roundoff.
    for e in live:
        if t[e] < 0.0:
            t[e] = 0.0
    # The route condition is h*(1-sum t)=0 with sum t nonnegative.  When
    # h>0, make the pressure sum exactly one in the natural live-edge order;
    # this avoids a large h multiplying a harmless last-bit summation error.
    if h > 0.0 and active_edges and sum(t[e] for e in live) != 1.0:
        target = max(active_edges, key=lambda ee: t[ee])
        others = 0.0
        for e in live:
            if e != target:
                others += t[e]
        corr = 1.0 - others
        if corr >= 0.0:
            t[target] = _f(corr)
    return z, t, _f(h)
"""
assert old in s
s=s.replace(old,new)
open(p,'w').write(s)
PY
